stories.title: Demonstranten verlaten straat omstreden Oranjemars Noord-Ierland

en.title: Demonstrators leave street of disputed Orange march in Northern Ireland
en.summary: Hundreds of demonstrators who blocked a controversial pro-British march in Portadown, Northern Ireland on Sunday have vacated the street they were blocking, though some residents remain to monitor the area.

stories.title: Betogers verlaten weg in Noord-Ierland na blokkade om omstreden Oranjemars tegen te houden

en.title: Protesters leave road in Northern Ireland after blockade against disputed Orange march
en.summary: Several thousand Catholic residents of Portadown assembled on Sunday to prevent a controversial Protestant march from passing through their neighborhood, with protest leaders planning talks with authorities on Monday.

stories.title: Katholieke betogers van straat, Oranjemars Noord-Ierland hele dag geblokkeerd

en.title: Catholic protesters off street, Orange march in Northern Ireland blocked all day
en.summary: Catholic protesters in Portadown prevented a controversial Orange march from taking place on Sunday by blocking Garvaghy Road until after midnight, though some residents remained and traffic eventually resumed.

stories.title: Israël zet Nederlandse diplomaten uit de Jordaanoever na importverbod

en.title: Israel expels Dutch diplomats from the Jordan Valley following import ban
en.summary: Israel has expelled Dutch diplomats from the Jordan Valley in response to an import ban imposed by the Netherlands.

stories.title: Oranje speelt stroef maar wint verdiend van Servië: goede start onder nieuwe bondscoach Xavi

en.title: Orange plays hesitantly but wins deservedly against Serbia: good start under new coach Xavi
en.summary: The Dutch national team defeated Serbia 2-1 away with two goals from young AZ striker Mexx Meerdink, creating many chances despite showing some defensive vulnerability.

stories.title: Israël trekt status in van Nederlandse diplomaten op Westoever om importverbod

en.title: Israel revokes diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats in West Bank over import ban
en.summary: Israel has withdrawn diplomatic status from Dutch diplomats in Ramallah following the Netherlands' trade embargo on products from the occupied West Bank. This action follows a similar move in the previous month involving Dutch representatives at an international Gaza support center.

stories.title: Israël zet Nederlandse diplomaten Ramallah uit vanwege boycot Israëlische producten

en.title: Israel expels Dutch diplomats from Ramallah over Israeli product boycott
en.summary: Israel has withdrawn diplomatic status from Dutch diplomats in Ramallah on the occupied West Bank, requiring them to leave within seven days, citing the Netherlands' import ban on goods from illegal settlements.

stories.title: Eerste overwinning onder bondscoach Xavi is binnen: Oranje wint met 2-1 van Servië in Nations League

en.title: First victory under coach Xavi secured: Orange wins 2-1 against Serbia in Nations League
en.summary: The Dutch national team achieved its first victory under new coach Xavi Hérnandez.

stories.title: Oranje boekt eerste zege onder Xavi dankzij twee goals Meerdink tegen Servië

en.title: Orange records first win under Xavi with two goals from Meerdink against Serbia
en.summary: The Dutch national team won 2-1 against Serbia in a Nations League match, with striker Mexx Meerdink scoring twice in his first game as a starter under coach Xavi Hérnandez.

stories.title: Omstreden parade van Oranjemannen in Noord-Ierland geblokkeerd, spanningen in de regering

en.title: Controversial Orange Order parade in Northern Ireland blocked, government tensions rise
en.summary: A controversial parade by the Orange Order in Northern Ireland has been blocked, creating tensions within the government.

stories.title: Britse politie arresteert vijf mannen die aanslag zouden hebben gepland op luchtmachtbasis van waaruit de VS Iran aanvalt

en.title: British police arrest five men accused of planning attack on air base used by US to strike Iran
en.summary: Five men have been arrested by British police on suspicion of planning an attack on RAF Fairford, a base from which the United States conducts military operations against Iranian targets. Iran's Revolutionary Guards previously designated the base as a legitimate target.

stories.title: Spanningen in Noord-Ierland lopen op rond protestantse Oranjemars die voor het eerst in bijna dertig jaar door katholieke wijk mag voeren

en.title: Tensions rise in Northern Ireland over Protestant Orange march through Catholic area for first time in nearly thirty years
en.summary: Residents of a Catholic neighborhood in Portadown, Northern Ireland plan to block a march by Protestant loyalists despite court approval. The Northern Ireland premier expressed concerns that allowing the march raises questions about the Good Friday Agreement.
